text.text:
The need for sustainable solutions comes into sharp focus when you consider that every bed in a hospital generates an average of 29 pounds of waste every day.1 Sustainability may not be every hospital's top priority. Their primary focus is delivering exceptional patient care, all while managing the challenges of staying within budget. Hospitals that reprocess with Stryker’s Sustainability Solutions (SSS) deliver measurable value while supporting operational goals.


Over the past five years, SSS has saved its customers $1 billion and prevented 26 million pounds of waste from reaching landfills.2 These achievements highlight the transformative potential of reprocessing when executed effectively. What sets SSS apart and what continues to drive our leadership in the reprocessing market is our focus on meeting customers’ needs.

Innovative solutions

Is your reprocessor’s advanced energy portfolio fully compatible with the latest OEM generator software? At SSS, reprocessed devices are every bit as advanced as those from original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and seamlessly integrate with existing OEM systems. OEMs use various tactics to limit the savings hospitals can achieve through reprocessing. SSS has developed advanced, proprietary technologies that keep reprocessed devices, including Ligasure, up to date with the latest software versions.

SSS solves today’s challenges and anticipates the challenges customers will face tomorrow. The company’s team is constantly analyzing market trends, OEM strategies, and emerging technologies like pulsed field ablation (PFA) to build robust, future-focused reprocessing programs. 

Savings and simplicity

SSS works with hospitals to implement comprehensive medical device reprocessing programs that deliver substantial savings. It's no accident that SSS is continuously first to market with products like reprocessed MyoSure, HARMONIC 1100 shears and LigaSure. We invest strategically in  reprocessing technologies for products that will result in significant cost savings and help hospitals manage budgets effectively.2

SSS prioritizes products that can be efficiently collected from the OR, EP lab, and patient floors, simplifying the process for staff. This streamlined collection approach drives reliable product availability and supports a continuous savings cycle that maximizes financial benefits for healthcare facilities.

Stability and constant improvement

SSS has been a leader in the reprocessing field for more than 20 years, partnering with over 3,250 hospitals across the US and Canada.2  We specialize in reprocessing high-impact, high-volume SKUs, in compliance with applicable standards, FDA regulations and guidance, as demonstrated through 510(k) clearances. Additionally, by investing in products with significant savings potential, we help impact the bottom line of customers’ facilities.2

Regular program reviews are a key feature of SSS's approach. A dedicated SSS sales representative works directly with hospital teams to evaluate progress, analyze trends and share best practices from other facilities. This ongoing collaboration allows customers to adapt and improve their program over time, strengthening its overall effectiveness.

Strong focus on sustainability

Hospitals are under increasing pressure to reduce their environmental footprint, and reprocessing programs can play a major role in achieving this goal. SSS invests in tools like Life Cycle Assessments (LCAs) that quantify the environmental benefits of reprocessing at a customer’s facility. With its proprietary technologies and processes, SSS is uniquely able to provide data-driven insights about reductions in waste, emissions, and resource consumption.

In addition to providing metrics, SSS empowers hospitals to share their sustainability achievements with key audiences, helping to amplify the positive impact of their efforts. This focus on transparency supports both internal engagement and broader recognition of the hospital’s commitment to environmentally responsible practices.

Conclusion

Reprocessing medical devices has evolved into a critical strategy for hospitals seeking to enhance efficiency, improve environmental outcomes, and maintain high standards of care. Programs led by SSS stand out for their comprehensive approach, combining attentive management, sustainability expertise, and a track record of reliability. By embracing these principles, hospitals can transform reprocessing into a cornerstone of operational excellence.
